# Step 2.90: Teams screens, browser test and paging

## Where things stood (item 1)

- The limit of 200 was `peopleShown` in `apps/web/src/features/teams-area/team-page.tsx`:
  a team's page read the league's first 200 people (by last name) into the "From the
  league list" select and the "League list" section. A league of more than 200 could not
  pick the 201st onward.
- The database-backed Teams port (`apps/web/src/server/database-admin-teams.ts`) runs
  core's `people.list_people` over the database people store, which calls
  `packages/database/src/queries/list-people.ts`: already a search by name and public
  name, by league ID, with `limit` and `offset` (test: "searches by name and public
  name, never by email, and pages" in `packages/database/src/stores/people-commands.test.ts`).
- The stand-in port (`apps/web/src/server/stand-in-world-teams.ts`, `list`) already
  searches and pages the same way.
- Done before this step: the query, its test and the stand-in search (step 2.50's People
  list uses them). Not done: the team page's search, and the browser test. Nothing is redone.
